results.name: active_blueprint
results.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX active_blueprint ON blueprints(course_id) WHERE active=1

results.name: attempt_questions
results.sql: CREATE TABLE attempt_questions(attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES attempts(id), question_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES questions(id), position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position BETWEEN 0 AND 24), prompt TEXT NOT NULL, choices_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(choices_json)), correct_index INTEGER NOT NULL, style TEXT NOT NULL, objective TEXT NOT NULL, difficulty TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(attempt_id,question_id), UNIQUE(attempt_id,position))

results.name: attempts
results.sql: CREATE TABLE attempts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, learner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES learners(id), course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id), blueprint_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES blueprints(id), policy_version TEXT NOT NULL, started_at INTEGER NOT NULL, deadline_at INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN('active','submitted','expired')), answers_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(answers_json)), score INTEGER, passed INTEGER CHECK(passed IN(0,1)), finalized_at INTEGER, pass_percent INTEGER NOT NULL, cooldown_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL)

results.name: audit_events
results.sql: CREATE TABLE audit_events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, actor_ref TEXT, event_type TEXT NOT NULL, object_ref TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK(json_valid(metadata_json)))

results.name: blueprints
results.sql: CREATE TABLE blueprints(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id), version TEXT NOT NULL, slots_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(slots_json)), duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(duration_seconds BETWEEN 300 AND 14400), pass_percent INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(pass_percent BETWEEN 1 AND 100), cooldown_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(cooldown_seconds>=0), active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(active IN(0,1)))

results.name: courses
results.sql: CREATE TABLE courses(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version TEXT NOT NULL, criteria_hash TEXT NOT NULL)

results.name: credentials
results.sql: CREATE TABLE credentials(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES attempts(id), learner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES learners(id), course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id), course_version TEXT NOT NULL, issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL, key_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES issuer_keys(id), digest TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, signed_document TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN('active','revoked')), revoked_at INTEGER)

results.name: eligibility
results.sql: CREATE TABLE eligibility(learner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES learners(id), course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id), approved_at INTEGER NOT NULL, evidence_ref TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(learner_id,course_id))

results.name: issuer_keys
results.sql: CREATE TABLE issuer_keys(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, public_jwk TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(public_jwk)), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN('active','retired','compromised')), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

results.name: learners
results.sql: CREATE TABLE learners(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, account_ref TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

results.name: one_active_attempt
results.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_attempt ON attempts(learner_id,course_id) WHERE status='active'

results.name: questions
results.sql: CREATE TABLE questions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, course_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(id), style TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(style IN('multiple_choice','true_false','output_prediction','error_identification','code_completion','code_ordering','debugging','trace_table','algorithm_selection','practical_coding')), objective TEXT NOT NULL, difficulty TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(difficulty IN('easy','medium','hard')), version TEXT NOT NULL, prompt TEXT NOT NULL, choices_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(choices_json)), correct_index INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(correct_index>=0), active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(active IN(0,1)))

results.name: rate_limits
results.sql: CREATE TABLE rate_limits(session_hash TEXT NOT NULL, window INTEGER NOT NULL, requests INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(session_hash,window))

results.name: sessions
results.sql: CREATE TABLE sessions(token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, learner_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES learners(id), expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(revoked IN (0,1)))
